questions.evidence:
PROJECT FILE: Each report contains seven black-and-white pages and one color cover. The class needs six identical copies. They will print the seven inside pages double-sided and put a single-sided color cover in front. Each finished copy therefore uses five sheets.

DESK PRICES: Each black-and-white printed side costs one dollar, and each color side costs five dollars. Stapling up to twenty sheets per document is free. The desk receives files until two for same-day pickup after three. The presentation begins at four.

TEAM MESSAGE: The file is ready at one forty-five. The team has eighty dollars. Ian suggests printing all eight pages in color for a better-looking report. Sara asks him to calculate the full cost before changing the order from the agreed mixed-color version.

They keep the mixed-color order and submit it immediately. At pickup, they count six complete copies and check each cover. The blank reverse side of the final inside sheet has no printing and adds no charge, but it is still part of the paper count.
questions.explanation: 七個黑白面七元，加一彩色面五元，共十二。
